mcp.instructions: LaughingFish MCP helps people plan time on the water. Each tool stands alone and does not know the others. You choose which to call. For a narrow question, call only the tool that answers it. For a plan on the water, call every tool that applies to that place and time and write one answer from all results. In-water or on-water recreation includes a water temperature lookup (current reading and history for trend) even if the user does not say water temperature. That includes fishing, swimming, water skiing, jet-skiing, snorkeling, scuba diving, spearfishing, windsurfing, kite surfing, surfing, boating, and similar water sports. Prefer water-temperature days 7 for a trip this week and days 30 when they ask about recent weeks or a pattern. Water temperature days is lookback, not a forecast. If no station is within range, say no in-situ reading is available. Do not invent water temperature or trend. Tomorrow uses weather hours 24. Next 3 days uses weather days 3. This week uses weather days 7. Convert relative dates to yyyy-MM-dd for solar times. Use resolve_location only when you need coordinates by themselves. Use server_health only to verify the host. Never expose NOAA station names or station IDs to the user.
